items.title: Jimmy Heath interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, September 8, 2014
items.q: Nas sampled me and, you know, I got big checks from his composition that he calls “One Love.”

ctx.x: When you go to the mail every day, this is sort of a personal question, but what kind of income might you receive that could be a surprise to you, from things you’ve done?

Well I think the biggest surprise was when I was sampled by a rapper by the name of Nas, whose father, Olu Dara, was a trumpet player. And Nas sampled me and, you know, I got big checks from his composition that he calls “One Love.” But all he used was a few bars.
